newsitem.title: UK: British brewer marks Royal split with bitter beer.
newsitem.headline: British brewer marks Royal split with bitter beer.

text.p: A British brewer has marked the divorce of Prince Charles and Princess Diana with a special bitter beer.
Brewers marked their 1981 marriage with several special brews and labels showing the devoted couple together.
Now they have split in an acrimonious divorce, Roger Abrahams of Buffy's Brewery in eastern England has marked the event with a bitter specially brewed for a beer festival.
It has two different labels. One shows the heir to the throne, the other his former wife.
"It's for all the grandmothers who feel they should never have divorced. They can now keep them together on the mantelpiece," Abrahams said.
